_about: MapleSyrup's own tunes, the ones it hums when it is happy. Every melody here is original (its rights say so); nothing from the game's soundtrack goes in — a hummed game theme reproduces its composition, and Nexon's terms allow no commercial use of it. The owner, a pianist, writes the leitmotifs; these first ones hold the place. A note is [pitch, beats], '-' a rest. The hum is synthesised at speech rate (24 kHz) and played through the same voice path as a line. A hum comes right after a thought and the player's window to answer opens when it ends, so a tune is a phrase of a few seconds, not a song.
